value.rationale: Strong positivity of the Galerkin system is required by the motivating reduced solver, but variance optimality alone does not preserve it. The result provides a sharp per-population design cutoff, explicit normalized contrast threshold for robust oracle variance correction, and exact demonstration that finite sketch averaging cannot repair support loss (only reduce failure probability). The four-row counterexample and equality frontier make this a motivated stability classification, with limited scalar/oracle scope acknowledged.
